scientific_limitations_and_integrity: For fixed D,r>0 and strictly contractive nonzero deterministic multiplier a, the stationary single-time density is smooth on the line, analytic exactly off zero, and nowhere Gevrey of finite order at zero. No claim for a=0, |a|>=1, random multipliers, non-Poisson clocks or multitime laws. All exact infinite-parameter claims have analytic proofs; finite checks are corroborative. The input stationary law and exponential expansion are credited to earlier authors. Scientific priority is not independently certified.
title: Smooth but nonanalytic core of Brownian proportional-reset equilibria
